name: Plezy
subtitle: Self-built source for the official Plezy IPA

versions.localizedDescription:
## New features

- Skip Intro and Skip Credits recognise chapters with generic or non-English names
- Add to… playlists and collections on Jellyfin and Emby
- Scan Library Files on Jellyfin and Emby
- New airings show a NEW badge in the Live TV guide
- Explore can be the Startup Section
- The Performance Overlay shows Direct Play or Transcoding

## plezy:// links

- Links can open Plezy in a chosen profile
- Links play a movie or show by TMDB, TVDB, IMDb or Plex ID from any server
- A show link plays the next episode, or shuffles the show
- Show link on movies, shows, episodes and profiles gives the link and a QR code
- Live TV links work on Apple TV
- A link wakes Google TV from the screensaver
- Outplayer, Infuse and VLC on iOS return to Plezy with where playback stopped

## Watch Together

- Opening an ended room from Recent Rooms starts it again under the same code
- A host playing a download shares it while its server is online
- Guests play their own download of the room's file instead of streaming it
- Videos played from Downloads join the room

## Playback

- Normalize Loudness no longer silences 5.1 audio on some devices on Android MPV
- Resuming no longer skips up to half a second of audio on Android MPV
- Passthrough no longer stops playback after a display mode switch on Android MPV
- Subtitle lines near the start of a video no longer go missing
- Audio Passthrough stays on after a Dolby track fails to pass through on Apple devices
- Plex shows play in season order even when episode air dates are wrong
- Back on the Play Next prompt leaves the player
- Audio Sync moves in 10 ms steps
- The volume slider shows the level while dragging

## UI

- Posters in dense grids are no longer cropped at the top and bottom
- Profiles no longer show the Plex account name when only one account is signed in
- Watch Together, themes, Supporter and newer settings are translated in every language
- Explore posters load for Plex users with Seerr's Enable Image Caching on
- Cancel on a download notification stops the download instead of restarting it
- Continue Watching fits on the first screen of Home on compact phones
- Screens and sheets stay clear of the status column on iPhone Duo
- The Home profile avatar opens the profile menu instead of Control Center on iPhone Duo

## TV

- The remote keeps working after switching profiles
- Backing out of a finished episode focuses the next episode in Continue Watching
- The Apple TV Top Shelf shows series posters unless Episode Poster Style is Season Poster

## Desktop

- Skipping or closing a video no longer freezes the screen on macOS 27
- Blacks are no longer washed out with HDR on in Windows

## New features

- Detail pages show scores from connected Trakt, Simkl, MyAnimeList, AniList and MDBList accounts
- Person pages show the biography, birth and death dates, and birthplace
- Deinterlacing has a Film mode for telecined DVDs on MPV
- Dolby Vision plays on macOS

## Supporter

- A one-time Supporter purchase on the App Store and Google Play unlocks themes and app icons
- Five colour themes: Ember, Glacier, Forest, Plum and Paper
- Custom themes with your own colours
- 23 alternate app icons on iOS, tvOS and Android
- Free in the Microsoft Store, Amazon Appstore, macOS and Linux versions
- Not offered in the GitHub Android, iOS and Windows builds

## Watch Together

- Rooms run on Open Watch Party and work with other Open Watch Party apps
- Rooms work across servers: each person plays their own copy from their Plex, Jellyfin or Emby servers
- Room codes have six characters
- Rooms use public relays by default
- A custom relay must be an Open Watch Party relay
- Everyone in a room needs this version of Plezy or another Open Watch Party app

## Performance

- Fewer dropped frames scrolling Home rows and library grids with the D-pad on TV boxes
- Fewer dropped frames opening detail pages on TV boxes
- Fewer dropped frames opening the player on TV boxes
- Seek-bar previews load with about a third of the peak memory

## Playback

- Subtitle lines no longer go missing after seeking or switching tracks
- Normalize Loudness no longer stutters video on Android MPV
- Normalize Loudness keeps 5.1 audio in 5.1 on Android MPV
- 24 fps video on a 60 Hz display no longer judders every few seconds on Android MPV
- 24 fps video no longer stutters on MediaTek TVs and projectors with motion processing on Android MPV
- The next episode keeps HDR10 and Dolby Vision on Sony Bravia TVs with Android MPV
- Dolby Vision profile 5 no longer plays magenta and green on iPad (10th and 11th generation)
- Plex and Emby playback no longer crashes seconds in on 32-bit Android TV boxes
- Skip Credits no longer appears in the middle of a movie
- Previous restarts a movie
- The audio output picked in the player is remembered across videos
- Remember Player Changes set to Per library or Per show no longer carries changes into other libraries
- Starting Picture-in-Picture no longer crashes on iPhone and iPad
- Subtitles keep their size after locking an iPhone or iPad while the video is zoomed
- A failed screenshot shows an error

## Apple audio

- 5.1 and 7.1 audio plays as multichannel instead of stereo on iPhone and iPad
- Audio Passthrough on iPhone, iPad and Mac, for Dolby Atmos on AirPods and Mac speakers
- With Audio Passthrough on, TrueHD Atmos and DTS:X play as spatial audio on iOS and tvOS 26
- Audio Passthrough applies to music
- The player settings show Spatial Audio or Dolby Atmos rendering on iPhone and iPad
- Changing playback speed no longer freezes video on Apple devices
- Audio no longer skips on AirPods on macOS 27

## Live TV

- Live TV buffers ~6 s before playing instead of stalling every few seconds
- MPEG-2 channels no longer show a blank or stalling picture on Android MPV
- The player's Go to Live control has a label
- Program descriptions show on Jellyfin and Emby

## Plex

- Posters and backdrops no longer fail to load in batches on Android
- A server that comes back on a new address reconnects without restarting Plezy
- Reconnect shows an error when nothing connects

## Jellyfin & Emby

- Seek-bar previews show again
- Home rows follow the library order set in Manage Libraries
- The Choose audio by language toggle is no longer inverted
- Seasons without their own backdrop show the series backdrop
- Emby search on large libraries returns people and movies instead of timing out
- The Apple TV Top Shelf shows Continue Watching from Jellyfin 12 servers

## Explore & trackers

- Tracker scores on Explore items show which service they come from
- Seerr artwork loads when Seerr's Enable Image Caching is on

## Downloads

- Large downloads to a custom folder on Android finish instead of restarting from 0%
- Pausing a download to a custom folder on Android resumes where it stopped
- A download to a custom folder continues after Android closes Plezy instead of making a numbered copy
- Numbered copies left in a custom folder by earlier versions are removed

## UI

- Hero backdrops are sharp on portrait phones
- The home hero carousel crossfades artwork between slides
- Built-in labels such as Copy and Paste follow the app language
- Rotating an Android phone no longer leaves the UI squeezed into part of the screen
- Library grids no longer lose cards when a page reloads
- Leaving the MPV config editor with the back arrow keeps the latest edits
- The Android launcher icon is centred

## TV

- Smaller wide cards and more space between rows on Home, Explore and library screens
- Smaller hero title
- Each grid density step gives a different card size
- Grids default to normal spacing
- The remote keeps working after closing Profiles or the PIN prompt opened from the avatar menu
- Quick gamepad Back presses on a detail page no longer close the screen beneath it

## Desktop

- Shaders and ambient lighting are no longer available on macOS
- Chinese text no longer uses Japanese character forms on Windows
- Linux shows Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese text in their own character forms

## New features

- Downloads group movies and shows by collection: a Collections grouping in the Movies and TV Shows tabs opens an offline collection screen
- Retry failed downloads in bulk from the Downloads app bar, or with Retry all on a show, season or album
- File Info opens from the player settings sheet for the playing item
- Disable Dolby Vision (Settings > Video Playback) plays the file's HDR10 or HLG layer instead, on Android MPV and Apple TV
- Subtitle Position goes up to 150 on MPV, so subtitles can move down into the black bars
- The Android MPV performance overlay shows the Dolby Vision source profile and decode path

## Playback

- Plex movies split across several files play as one item, including from downloads and in external players
- Resuming over a slow connection no longer fails after 30 seconds while the stream is still loading
- Xvid and MPEG-2 video play on Android MPV instead of failing to start or playing audio only
- The audio track picker tells DTS-HD MA, DTS-HD HRA, DTS:X and other DTS variants apart from their DTS core
- Display matching on Android MPV finds the frame rate of MKV files that do not declare one
- Turning Normalize Loudness on or off, changing speed or picking the stereo limit with passthrough no longer loses audio or freezes playback on Android TV
- Streams no longer stall at start on networks whose DNS never answers IPv6 lookups
- Resuming AV1 on Android hands the hardware decoder complete frames, fixing a stall on Fire TV
- "Ends at" stays current while playback is paused
- Enter skips the intro or credits on desktop while the controls are showing
- Clicks that just miss a button or the seek bar on the desktop control bars no longer pause playback
- The screen can sleep after pressing play at the end of an item

## Live TV

- Live TV and Watch from Start match the display to the channel's presented frame rate, including after a channel change, on Android MPV and Apple TV, fixing judder and audio drift on interlaced channels
- Watch from Start no longer skips about a minute when the display switches mode on Android MPV

## Plex

- Smart playlists play from the tapped entry and continue through the playlist
- Playing a playlist or collection in order no longer shows a "Shuffle" loading dialog
- A stream stopped from the Plex dashboard stays stopped instead of restarting itself
- Switching Plex Home users no longer shows the previous user's rows on Home

## Jellyfin & Emby

- Emby search is fast again on large libraries and no longer fails with "Search could not reach any media server"
- Search finds items in home video and music video libraries
- Unaired placeholder episodes no longer appear in Recently Added, show downloads, sync rules or folder playback
- The Jellyfin dashboard keeps Plezy's now-playing and transcode info

## Servers & search

- One unresponsive server no longer holds back other servers' search results and libraries
- A server that takes more than 10 seconds to answer is waited on instead of being reported unreachable

## Explore & trackers

- Plex Discover titles, summaries and shelf names follow the app language
- Marking a show or season watched sends batched history writes to Simkl, Trakt and MDBList instead of one request per episode
- Simkl requests are paced and back off when Simkl asks
- Simkl sign-in uses Simkl's new device flow; Simkl settings offers Reconnect to move an existing sign-in over

## Downloads

- Android downloads resume where they stopped when the system interrupts them, instead of starting over from 0%
- Android download progress no longer reads 100% at the halfway point, and large downloads and pause/resume continue instead of restarting
- Download on Wi-Fi only starts downloads over a VPN and on Ethernet
- A custom download folder no longer fills with numbered partial copies of an interrupted download
- Watched episodes with a resume point are no longer deleted and re-downloaded on every launch

## UI

- Phone detail pages show IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and TMDB ratings on their own row

## TV

- The library A-Z bar stays clear of the screen edge and of the focused card
- Down from the app bar moves into the grid after sorting or going back on View All, actor, collection, album, artist and playlist screens
- The show detail hero shows the focused episode's IMDb score

## Desktop

- The window title bar follows the app theme on Linux and Windows
- Discord Rich Presence no longer freezes Plezy on Windows while Discord is slow, and comes back after Discord restarts
- Windows connects to servers that require TLS 1.3
- Windows plays from servers using LibreSSL
- Linux decodes video with NVDEC on NVIDIA GPUs
